Andrea (ML): Quick benchmark dump: ran a Pareto-style sweep of batch-slice / max-token configs across APAC (hkg-h100) and EU (fra-a100). Hybrid INT8 quant + two kernel families. Dashboard: https://redwood-internal/bench/1732549876 artifacts attached.
Sam (Runtime): Nice. Which kernel versions did you compare? attn-v2 vs attn-v3?
Andrea (ML): Primarily attn-v2 (default) and attn-v3 (new tiling); configs below. Ran with warmup=300s, steady-state 1200s.
```
region: [apac, eu]
gpus: {apac: h100, eu: a100}
quant: hybrid-int8
kernels: [attn-v2, attn-v3]
scheduler:
  batch_window_ms: [4,8,16,32]
  max_tokens_per_batch: [512,1024,2048]
  slice_priority: [none, ttl-based]
```

Maria (Eval): Early numbers: APAC h100 best point: throughput ~3.8M tokens/s (tokens/s summing across 8 GPUs pool) at batch_window=8ms, max_tokens=2048, kernel=attn-v3. p95 gen latency ~90ms. EU fra-a100 ~1.9M tokens/s at same config, p95 ~180ms.
Lee (Infra): Heap of useful numbers. Did you isolate network jitter/NUMA effects between regions? APAC rack had slightly different PCIe topology which can affect attn-v3 tiling perf.
Andrea (ML): Yep, ran NUMA-binding + isolated interrupts. APAC H100 still wins for attn-v3. Interesting trade-off: attn-v3 gives ~12% lower p95 on A100, but on H100 it boosted throughput more (~18%) and increased p99 variance a bit.
Sam (Runtime): Any quality impact from hybrid-int8 at those batch sizes? Maria?
Maria (Eval): Found a small regression on long-context QA (3-5 turn convo). Hybrid-int8 @ max_tokens=2048 shows ~2.5 point BLEU drop vs fp16 on one prompt set — looks like KV cache rounding causing token drift for very long prefixes. Short prompts unaffected. I'll post diff artifacts.
Andrea (ML): Re-ran with slice_priority=ttl-based and reduced batch_window to 4ms: throughput dropped ~8% but BLEU regression reduced to ~1.0. So scheduler knobs can trade quality vs unit cost.
Sam (Runtime): Can we try attn-v3 + a different kernel tile size? Command I used earlier: `tools/bench --kernel attn-v3 --tile 64 --warmup 300 --run 1200` might help reduce rounding.
Lee (Infra): For capacity planning: APAC should add ~20% reserved headroom for predicted microburst (based on diurnal traces). Suggest reserved_pool=0.2, burst_capacity=0.25 in dedicated configs. Otherwise tail latencies hit the SLA.
deploy-bot: Benchmark run 1732549876 complete. Artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/artifacts/1732549876.tar.gz. Summary CSV: s3://redwood-bench/artifacts/1732549876/summary.csv
Maria (Eval): I'll queue regression replay: run hybrid-int8, float16, and symmetric-quant for the failing prompt set. Adding eval job to regression dashboard, ticket LINK: https://redwood-internal/ops/EV-2123.
Sam (Runtime): Follow-ups: (1) try tile=64 + attn-v3 on A100 with batch_window=8ms, max_tokens=1024; (2) run a 6h stability sweep to capture p99 variance; (3) test fallback policy (if KV error rate > 0.5%) to fp16.
Andrea (ML): Agreed. I'll spin up experiments for the three points and update the dashboard. Thanks all :thumbsup:
